about: A speed tie forced both ways (NEWGOLD_DIAG's gDiagForceSpeedTie): a level-12 Cyndaquil against a forced wild level-5 Geodude, both given Speed 40 in the running battle (set:), so CheckSortSpeed rolls for who goes first. With the switch at 1 the roll says the second battler asked -- the Geodude -- moves first; at 2, the Cyndaquil. Cyndaquil uses Leer, so no stat stage moves either Speed. The field's RNG is pinned as in rolls_forced_high.json.
